description:
An alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform

Keyguard is an alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform, created to provide the best user experience possible.
Highlights:
- a beautiful rich and responsive Material You user interface;
- a powerful and fast search;
- a support for creating & using passkeys - a modern alternative to passwords.
- a watchtower that finds items with Pwned passwords, Vulnerable accounts, Reused passwords, Inactive two factor authentication, Inactive passkeys, Unsecure Websites as well as Duplicate, Incomplete and Expiring items, and other;
- multi-account support 🌠 with secure login and two-factor authentication support;
- add items 🌠 and sends 🌠, modify 🌠, and view your vault offline;
- export individual or organization items, including the attachments;
- beautiful Light/Dark theme;
- a generator with SSH keys, Email forwarders, Custom wordlists support, and many other features;
- a support for placeholders and URL overrides;
- and much more!
🌠 - on Android requires the Premium one-time or subscription license.
New
- Desktop: Added launching at login and starting in the background (#1497, #1575).
- Vault: Added scanning plaintext SSH and .env files on disk to import them to the vault.
Improvements
- Vault: KDF parameters can now be customized (#1690).
- Vault: The vault key is now protected with a single Argon2id run instead of 2.
- Browser extension: Inline and search popups now allow adding a new item.
- Browser extension: Suggested logins are now separated from matched ones.
- Browser extension: Auto-filling rules are now handled better.
- Browser extension: Extension settings are now regrouped.
- Wear OS: Swiping back now shows an animated preview on Wear OS 5 or older (#1590).
- Data: Updated translations.
Fixes
- Android: Fixed Galaxy Watch companion authentication crashing the Android app (#1688).
- Bitwarden: Fixed vault items not showing as being in a collection (#576).
- Windows: Fixed installation failing to create a Start menu entry (#1115).
- macOS: Fixed the Quick search shortcut so it uses Cmd+Option+\ to avoid collision with Apple Intelligence.
